afterlifes_delight.configuration.title: Afterlife's Delight Settings
afterlifes_delight.configuration.allowGh: Allow ghosts to fly using the vanilla creative-flight controls.
afterlifes_delight.configuration.ghostCo: Chance per second for a Sable corpse to slip from a ghost's hands. Range: 0–100%.
How many seconds a ghost must wait before grabbing a slipped Sable corpse again. Range: 0–60.
afterlifes_delight.configuration.deathSo: Format: sound ID, volume, pitch. Example: minecraft:entity.warden.sonic_charge 1.0 1.0. Use none to disable.
afterlifes_delight.configuration.resurre: Format: sound ID, volume, pitch. Example: minecraft:entity.warden.sonic_boom 1.0 1.0. Use none to disable.
afterlifes_delight.configuration.enableG: Enable the ghostly particles, fog, cold filter and ambient sound.
afterlifes_delight.configuration.ghostAt: Controls the intensity of ghostly particles, fog and the cold filter. Range: 0.0–1.0.
afterlifes_delight.configuration.ghostAm: Controls the volume of the ghost world's ambient sound. Range: 0.0–1.0.
afterlifes_delight.configuration.enableG: Enable camera sway when entering or leaving the ghost world.
afterlifes_delight.configuration.ghostTr: Controls camera sway and field-of-view distortion during the transition. Range: 0.0–2.0.
